How It Works

From screen recording to published tutorial
in three steps

No editing experience needed. Record once — Deliveny takes care of the rest.

Record the workflow

Walk through the feature like you'd explain it to a customer. No script, no filming skills — a 2–3 minute screen recording is enough.

Deliveny understands it

It listens to your voiceover, sees which button you mean, and zooms straight to it. Captions, step callouts, and your branding — added automatically.

Publish anywhere

Everything stays editable. Tweak any overlay, swap the music, then export in one click — and embed it in your help center, your support tool, or your onboarding emails.

Questions, answered

What do I need to record?

Just a screen recording with your voiceover — you talking through the workflow. Any screen recorder works, including the one already built into your Mac or PC.

Do I need any editing skills?

No. Deliveny generates a complete first draft — zooms, captions, step callouts, branding. If you want to tweak something, everything stays editable in a simple timeline editor.

How does Deliveny know where to zoom?

It listens to your voiceover, understands which step or button you're explaining, and finds that element on screen. The zooms and highlights follow your explanation automatically.

How is this different from a screen recorder or a step-by-step documentation tool?

A screen recorder hands you the raw take and stops there. Documentation tools turn it into written steps, or a click-through demo that lives on their platform. Deliveny turns the same recording into a polished, branded video file you own — the kind you'd put in your help center or on your homepage.

What happens when my product's UI changes?

Re-record the workflow and regenerate. Your brand kit, style, and structure carry over — no starting from scratch.

Your next tutorial is a 10-minute recording away.
